# Vendored contract — do not edit

These files are generated by the server repository and vendored here unchanged.
Do not edit them. To change a shape, file a request with the server team and consume
the next contract version. `pnpm contract:verify` fails if any file was modified.

Current version: see `MANIFEST.json`.

To upgrade a version (from `docs/CLIENT-PLAN.md` §3.5):

1. Read the incoming `CHANGELOG.md` first.
2. Replace this directory wholesale — never merge selectively.
3. Run `pnpm typecheck`. The compiler names every call site that broke.
4. Fix them. Do not widen types to silence errors.
5. Update `NEXT_PUBLIC_CONTRACT_VERSION` and record the bump in `docs/PROGRESS.md`.
